title: SignerListSet
key_points: SignerListSet is a transaction type in the XRP Ledger.
It sets the list of accounts that are allowed to sign transactions for a trust line or account root.
The transaction creator can specify a new set of signers, remove existing signers, or both.
If no accounts are specified, SignerListSet removes all current signers.
limitations: The source assumes familiarity with the XRP Ledger and its concepts.
asserts: SignerListSet transactions allow the creator to manage which accounts can sign transactions for a trust line or account root.
scope: Explains how SignerListSet transactions work in the context of managing signer permissions in the XRP Ledger.
